```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  echo = FALSE,
  include = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
appNames <- c(
    "imageTCGA",
    "BiocPkgDash",
    "BiocHubsShiny",
    "BugSigDBEnrich",
    "curatedMetagenomicDataCurationShiny",
    "PowerCalc",
    "primers"
)
applinks <- paste("https://shiny.sph.cuny.edu/app", appNames, sep = "/")
picfiles <- file.path("~/Pictures", "shinysnaps", paste0(appNames, ".png"))
stopifnot(
    all(file.exists(picfiles))
)
```

# imageTCGA

```{r,out.width='100%', fig.link = applinks[1], include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(picfiles[1])
```
